Published numeric intake: 180
fields.Fees — Published: ₹4.46 lakh approx. [Unverified legacy reference; not a confirmed current full-programme fee.]
fields.Fee Scope: The official notice establishes ₹2,23,200 second-year annual fee for an existing batch in 2026–27; it does not establish a 2026 entrant two-year total.
fields.CAT / Exam Cutoff: 2026–27 CAT-route counselling, Round 3 (3 August 2026), closing merit ranks: Delhi General 520; Outside Delhi General 514. These are GGSIPU allotment ranks, not CAT percentiles; category and shift apply.
fields.Eligibility: Bachelor’s degree; current minimum-mark/category rules not located in an official 2026 notice
fields.Selection Process: GGSIPU central counselling by CAT/CMAT/CET merit, document verification and seat allotment.
fields.Application / Vacancy Signal: Historical IPU vacancy notice dated 12 Sep 2026; current seats on 7 Oct 2026 not verified
fields.Median CTC — Published:
₹4.50 LPA for MBA graduates, reported in Careers 360 NIRF 2025 placement table (2023–24 graduating cohort).
Reported median ₹L: 4.5
fields.Placement — Published:
120 of 172 MBA graduates placed; 69.77% of graduates (derived), from Careers 360 NIRF 2025 table.
Published/calculated rate %: 69.77
fields.Placement Scope: MBA-only secondary NIRF 2025 table: 2023–24 median ₹4.50 LPA and 120/172 graduates placed; engineering placement statistics excluded.
fields.Programme-Aligned Career Paths: Business/Strategy Consultant; Product/Program Manager; Operations; Sales/Brand; Finance Analyst
fields.Notes: Official central MAIT2026-27 notice confirms MBA second-year fee ₹2,23,200 for 2025 entrants; do not double it into a confirmed two-year 2026 quote. Department mgmt.mait.ac.in currently serves unrelated content, so it cannot validate MBA salaries. Central placement table is engineering-dominated, with 90 L institution-wide maximum, and is not assigned to MBA.
